user.description: Mobile App notification devices and speakers are discovered automatically. After setup, open Configure to add one or more named Zalo destinations.

data.confirm_targets: Ask which destinations and speakers to use before saving each reminder
data.speaker_enabled: Offer discovered speakers as reminder destinations

data.zalo_home_assistant_enabled: Allow Zalo to query and control Home Assistant

data_description.confirm_targets: Voice Assist and Zalo commands list discovered phones, Zalo destinations, and speakers, then wait for a reply such as: choose 1 and 3.
data_description.speaker_enabled: Compatible media_player entities are scanned automatically whenever a reminder is created.
data_description.tts_entity_id: Optional. If left unset, Conversational Assistant automatically uses the first available TTS entity.
data_description.zalo_webhook_enabled: Does not create a new endpoint. Your existing webhook or automation calls conversational_assistant.process_zalo_webhook and passes its JSON body in the payload field.
data_description.zalo_webhook_bot_account_id: Required when Zalo webhook processing is enabled. Enter the bot account ID from your own Zalo webhook payload; it is used with isSelf and uidFrom to ignore messages sent by the bot itself.
data_description.zalo_webhook_account_selection: The account selector expected by zalo_bot.send_message, usually the bot phone number. If empty, the first configured Zalo destination account is used.
data_description.zalo_home_assistant_enabled: Routes device control, state, room, area, floor, weather, and calendar requests from Zalo into Home Assistant. Only entities exposed to Assist can be used.
data_description.zalo_conversation_agent_id: Choose the Home Assistant or custom Conversation agent that should interpret Zalo commands. Home Assistant Assist exposure settings are still enforced for calendars and built-in controls.
data_description.ai_search_agent_id: Choose an Internet-capable Conversation agent. It handles Vietnamese and English search requests separately from the agent used to control Home Assistant.
data_description.ai_image_task_entity_id: Choose an AI Task entity that supports ai_task.generate_image. Image requests received from Zalo are sent to this agent and the completed image is returned to the same conversation.
data_description.ai_agent_failover_enabled: Enabled by default. The integration always tries the selected agent first. If it errors, returns no usable result, or times out, compatible agents available in Home Assistant are tried in sequence. Every agent receives a fresh timeout window, and Zalo reports the switch and total number of attempted agents.
data_description.ai_camera_task_entity_id: Choose an AI Task entity that supports ai_task.generate_data with camera attachments. It analyzes selected cameras for Voice Assist and Zalo.
data_description.ai_camera_instructions: Instructions sent to ai_task.generate_data for every selected camera. The default is the same camera-analysis prompt used in earlier versions; leaving it empty restores that default.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Conversational Assistant instance is supported.

init.title: Conversational Assistant options
init.description: Settings are organized by feature. Currently configured Zalo destinations: {zalo_count}.

general.title: General settings
general.description: Configure shared confirmation and notification behavior for Conversational Assistant.

data.dismiss_on_clear: Treat swiping away as dismiss (Android only)
data.confirm_targets: Ask which destinations and speakers to use before saving each reminder

data_description.confirm_targets: When enabled, both Voice Assist and Zalo reminders are saved only after you reply with destination numbers or names.

calendar.title: Calendar settings
calendar.description: Choose the calendars to scan and notify. Found {calendar_count} calendars, {mobile_count} Mobile App devices, and {zalo_count} enabled Zalo destinations. Submit saves immediately and reloads the notification schedule.

data.calendar_lookahead_days: Number of upcoming days to scan
data.calendar_entities: Calendars to monitor and include in notifications
data.calendar_notification_enabled: Send a daily calendar notification when events exist

data_description.calendar_lookahead_days: Default: 30 days. The sensor only counts selected calendars and hides ordinary lunar dates without event content while keeping lunar day 1, day 15, and meaningful events.
data_description.calendar_entities: Only selected calendars are included in the sensor and daily summary. Selecting none disables calendar scanning.
data_description.calendar_notification_enabled: When enabled, the integration refreshes at the selected time and sends when events exist. A failure in one calendar no longer blocks valid events from other calendars.
data_description.calendar_notification_time: Local Home Assistant time. Default: 07:00 every day.
data_description.calendar_notification_mobile_devices: Select one or more Mobile App devices that always receive the calendar summary.
data_description.calendar_notification_zalo_targets: Select one or more enabled Zalo destinations already configured in Zalo settings.

zalo.title: Zalo settings
zalo.description: Manage the webhook and {zalo_count} configured Zalo destinations.

menu_options.zalo_webhook: Zalo webhook and Home Assistant access

zalo_webhook.title: Zalo webhook and Home Assistant
zalo_webhook.description: Configure command processing from your existing webhook, the bot account used for replies, and Home Assistant access.

data.zalo_webhook_enabled: Process commands from an existing Zalo webhook
data.zalo_home_assistant_enabled: Allow Zalo to query and control Home Assistant

data_description.zalo_webhook_enabled: Does not create a new endpoint. Your existing webhook or automation calls conversational_assistant.process_zalo_webhook and passes its JSON body in the payload field.
data_description.zalo_webhook_bot_account_id: Required when webhook processing is enabled. Enter the bot account ID from your payload so messages sent by the bot itself can be ignored.
data_description.zalo_webhook_account_selection: The account_selection value expected by zalo_bot, usually the bot phone number. If empty, the first configured Zalo destination account is used.
data_description.zalo_home_assistant_enabled: Routes device control, state, room, area, floor, weather, and calendar requests from Zalo into Home Assistant. Only entities exposed to Assist can be used.

ai.title: AI settings
ai.description: Select separate agents for Zalo conversation, Internet search, AI image generation, and camera analysis; edit camera instructions and configure automatic AI failover.

data.ai_search_agent_id: AI Agent Search for Internet queries
data.ai_image_task_entity_id: AI Task agent for image generation
data.ai_agent_failover_enabled: Automatically try other AI agents when the preferred agent fails
data.ai_camera_task_entity_id: AI Task agent for camera analysis

data_description.zalo_conversation_agent_id: The agent that interprets Zalo commands and controls Home Assistant. Assist exposure settings are still enforced.
data_description.ai_search_agent_id: An Internet-capable agent that separately handles Vietnamese and English search requests.
data_description.ai_image_task_entity_id: An AI Task entity supporting ai_task.generate_image. Completed images are returned to the same Zalo conversation with zalo_bot.send_image.
data_description.ai_agent_failover_enabled: Enabled by default. The integration always tries the selected agent first. If it errors, returns no usable result, or times out, compatible agents available in Home Assistant are tried in sequence. Every agent receives a fresh timeout window, and Zalo reports the switch and total number of attempted agents.
data_description.ai_camera_task_entity_id: An AI Task entity supporting ai_task.generate_data and camera attachments. The selected agent is tried first; compatible AI Task entities are used as failover when enabled.
data_description.ai_camera_instructions: Editable instructions sent to the AI Task for each selected camera. The default is the exact prompt used in earlier versions; leaving it empty restores the default.
